diagnostics: Training uses 336 observations ending before the 30-day holdout.
Method selection uses only rolling-origin folds inside the training window.
The committed actual holdout is compared only after the forecast is compiled.
Selected seasonal-naive by minimum rolling-origin WAPE, then MAE.
Calibrated the interval radius from 240 held-out errors.
All candidate exclusions and fold-level predictions remain serialized for audit.
limitations: Backtest performance does not establish causal effects or future policy impact.
Intervals are split-conformal-style empirical residual bands over the declared folds; they do not guarantee coverage under distribution shift.
Baseline methods omit exogenous variables, structural breaks, and operational feedback.
This is a historical public-data replay, not a live forecast or production service.
One gridded point does not represent municipal exposure or intervention outcomes.
Forty replay records are repeated tasks over 20 source artifacts and two parameters, not 40 independent cities or studies.
